text:
### Right to Restrict Processing  
**Customer Right:** Limit how data used (but not require deletion)  
**Scenario Example:**
- Customer disputes accuracy
- Data processing while accuracy under dispute
- Data marked "restricted" in system
- Limited processing only for legal obligations
name: Chunk 14/36

raw_entities.name: Right to Restrict Processing Policy
raw_entities.description: Policy governing the customer right to restrict processing of personal data without requiring deletion. Applies when customers dispute data accuracy or wish to limit processing scope while disputes are resolved. Data marked as restricted in system with processing limited to legal obligations only.
context: Limit how data used (but not require deletion)
Limited processing only for legal obligations

raw_entities.name: Customer Right to Dispute Data Accuracy
raw_entities.description: Provision enabling customers to dispute the accuracy of personal data held by the bank. Upon dispute, data processing is restricted pending resolution of the accuracy challenge.
context: Data processing while accuracy under dispute

raw_entities.name: Data Restriction Marking in System
raw_entities.description: Requirement to mark disputed or restricted data as 'restricted' within the bank's data management systems to prevent unauthorized or unnecessary processing.

raw_entities.name: Limited Processing During Restriction Period
raw_entities.description: Obligation to limit data processing to legal obligations only when data has been marked as restricted due to accuracy disputes or customer restriction requests.
context: Limited processing only for legal obligations

raw_entities.name: Data Accuracy Risk
raw_entities.description: Risk that personal data held by the bank may be inaccurate or outdated, potentially leading to incorrect decisions or customer harm. This policy addresses mitigation through customer dispute rights and processing restrictions.
context: Data processing while accuracy under dispute

raw_entities.name: Data Restriction Flagging System
raw_entities.description: Technical control measure that flags or marks customer data as 'restricted' within the bank's systems to prevent processing beyond legal obligations while accuracy disputes are pending.
context: Limited processing only for legal obligations

raw_entities.name: Customer
raw_entities.description: Individual customer with the right to restrict processing of their personal data, including the ability to dispute data accuracy and request limitation of processing scope.
context: Customer Right: Limit how data used
